transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As we discussed, the replayable webhook service is planned for production enablement next Monday. I've reviewed the current draft of the operating policy, which allows each tenant 100 webhook requests per minute, runs 8 replay workers, retains payload bodies for 30 days, and currently includes no targeted customer notice. Before I sign off on this policy, I want to follow our standard round-robin review. Could reliability and customer success each state any final operational or customer commitments they see as relevant to this enablement?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While tuning an unrelated queue dashboard this morning, I found that the reserved production capacity can support the webhook service only with a per-tenant limit of exactly 60 requests per minute and exactly 3 replay workers. The draft's 100 requests per minute and 8 replay workers would exceed the reservation. I have not updated the policy ticket yet. Before sign-off, a capacity-review commitment is required to document the adjusted rate limit and worker count against the reservation.
